name: CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III
summary: CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III, Ltd currently conducts no significant business operations. Its primary objective is to finalize a business combination, which may involve a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or corporate reorganization, with one or more enterprises operating in the technology, financial services, or media sectors. Established in 2024, the company is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
